canonical_project: Microsoft Saudi Arabia East cloud datacenter region
notes: Microsoft confirmed its Saudi Arabia East datacenter region in the Eastern Province will be available for customer workloads from Q4 2026, with three availability zones (independent power/cooling/networking); construction of the region's sites is reported complete. Exact city not disclosed by Microsoft; Infra/trade posts place the contracted facility in Dammam. Status planned until the region goes live (Q4 2026); recorded under Ad Dammam per Eastern Province/Dammam sourcing.
